channel.title: Rochdale Daily

item.title: East Lancashire Railway steam gala draws more than 2,000 passengers as numbers rise 21.4 per cent

item.title: Are there really fairies in Healey Dell?
item.description: Short answer: no—there’s no evidence for supernatural visitors, but the place-name, a nineteenth‑century literary tradition and a distinctive rock ‘chapel’ have combined to make Healey Dell one of Rochdale’s best-loved bits of local folklore.
